upstream.description: AI agents running research on single-GPU nanochat training automatically

classification.analysis: Autoresearch, from Andrej Karpathy, is a minimal single-GPU LLM training harness designed to be driven autonomously by a coding agent (Claude/Codex) overnight: the agent edits train.py (a simplified nanochat GPT implementation with Muon+AdamW optimizer), runs fixed 5-minute training experiments, checks the val_bpb metric, and keeps or discards changes in a loop guided by a program.md instruction file. It's aimed at ML researchers and hobbyists experimenting with agent-driven neural architecture/hyperparameter search on a single NVIDIA GPU (tested on H100). The repo is intentionally tiny (three files) and had a short burst of activity in March 2026 with community forks adding macOS/Windows/AMD support.

use_cases.title: Let a coding agent autonomously iterate on a small GPT training loop overnight
Study a minimal single-GPU nanochat-style training implementation
Prototype agent-driven hyperparameter/architecture search on limited compute
